axelat3: Ulrich Axelat arrived with the evening ration party, carrying his mother's thimble and a borrowed greatcoat two sizes too big.
The colonel shook hands with the first hundred, one by one. Ulrich Axelat was number 28. He still remembers how cold the colonel's glove was.

Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Ulrich Axelat read a theatre review while peeling supper. Victory at Verdel Ridge. Ulrich Axelat let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Ulrich Axelat cut Valentin Zle's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short.
the_cowboii: Tobias "Crow" Cowboii was a baker in Kesselby until the posters went up. He came to S-F14 with a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts, and within a day the whole bay knew that he collects shell fuses.
Tobias "Crow" Cowboii received the First Wave ribbon. He checked the stitching twice before putting the tunic back on.
Tobias "Crow" Cowboii cut his hand to the bone on the wire at the Bone Quarry. Iodine, a bandage, and a lecture from the medic.

Tobias "Crow" Cowboii's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it. Verdel Ridge has been won. Tobias "Crow" Cowboii listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Tobias "Crow" Cowboii had Severin Lagbagdotzip of the Hegemony in the sights at the Chalk Pits for a long second. Severin Lagbagdotzip was lighting a pipe. Tobias "Crow" Cowboii let the match burn all the way down.
